apps.localizedDescription:
Torrent Control for Safari:

A Safari Web Extension port of Mika-/torrent-control for macOS and iOS/iPadOS. Send magnet links and .torrent files to a remote BitTorrent client (qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, and others) right from Safari.

Based on torrent-control 0.2.48. See Updating from upstream.

Features:

• Add magnets and .torrent files to your torrent client without leaving Safari.
• macOS: right-click a link → Torrent Control → add (with label / server / paused / advanced options), or auto-add on click via Catch torrent URLs.
• iOS/iPadOS: tap a magnet or .torrent link → a native bottom-sheet picker (choose label, server, paused).

Option A — Sideload the iOS .ipa:

SideStore or Sideloadly using your own Apple ID (they re-sign it for you). Then enable the extension in Safari as above.
